steps: Fresh incognito context, /studio-lab 1280x720, Decline. Add one Middle East clip with Enter, Fit, Snap on.
Drag on the clip at 75% of its height from t=3 s to t=12 s to make a range, blur, press Ctrl+L (loop 00:03-00:12 on). Move the loop to 00:00-00:09 with the focused brace and ArrowLeft.
Blur, hold Control, then send keyboard.down('l') 10 times (1 press + 9 auto-repeats).
bugs.expected: A held Ctrl+L acts once, like the guarded Ctrl+D/Space, or at least leaves a predictable state.
bugs.actual: The loop toggles on every auto-repeat. The loop button's aria-pressed per keydown was true,false,true,false,true,false,true,false,true,false. The final state depends on how long the key was held (here: loop off, 'Loop 00:03.000 — 00:12.000 · off'). The first press also re-applied the still-selected range (3-12) over the moved loop (0-9). The Undo label ended at 'Undo: Loop გამორთვა'; C did not count how many history entries were added. Pre-existing, outside this round's scope. This confirms code-reviewer F6 in a real browser.
